name: Palo Alto Cortex XDR / XSIAM — IOC hunting
description: XQL queries over the xdr_data dataset. The time range is selected in the query editor, so it never appears in the query text.

templates.name: Connections to the IP addresses
templates.description: Story and endpoint network events pointing at the indicators.
templates.body:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, actor_process_image_name,
         action_local_ip, action_remote_ip, action_remote_port
| sort desc _time

templates.name: Connections summarised per host
templates.description: Scoping view: which endpoints talked to the indicators and how often.
templates.body:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| comp count() as hits, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen
       by agent_hostname, action_remote_ip
| sort desc hits

templates.name: DNS queries for the domains
templates.description: Endpoint DNS telemetry, which resolves before the proxy sees the request.
templates.body:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, dns_query_name, action_remote_ip
| sort desc _time

templates.name: Processes matching the hashes
templates.description: Process execution keyed on the image hash.
templates.body:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_name,
         action_process_image_command_line, {{field}}
| sort desc _time

templates.name: Files written matching the hashes
templates.description: Dropped payloads that may never have executed.
templates.body:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| fields _time, agent_hostname, action_file_path, action_file_name, {{field}}, actor_process_image_name
| sort desc _time

templates.name: Indicators in a command line
templates.description: Regex match against the full command line of every process.
templates.body:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and {{field}} ~= "{{iocs|regex}}"
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_command_line
| sort desc _time
